tools.chisel: Chisel: knocks off crusty rust and splits seams.
tools.torch: Butane torch: heats metal until it glows so it can be freed, bent or brazed.
tools.grind: Rotary grinder: wire wheel, burr or sanding disc that takes metal back to bright steel.
tools.stain: Stain brush: brushes on liquids such as bluing, oil, stain or stripper.
tools.hammer: Hammer: drives out and peens rivets.
tools.scraper: Paint scraper: lifts loose scale and old paint in strips.
tools.punch: Pin punch: drives pins out with hammer taps.
tools.pick: Metal pick: picks heavy rust crust off detailed areas.
tools.soap: Soap brush: scrubs off grime and residue with soapy water.
tools.file: Metal file: straightens and evens edges.
tools.buff: Buffing wheel: polishes metal, brass or plastic to a mirror shine.
tools.tweez: Tweezers: lifts out and places small parts.
tools.pliers: Pliers: grips and pulls small parts out.
tools.paint: Spray paint: sprays an even colour coat.
tools.press: Press tool: presses parts in or out and straightens bends.
tools.soft: Soft brush: sweeps away dust and crumbs without scratching.
tools.cloth: Polishing cloth: rubs metal to a soft shine.
tools.puller: Keycap puller: pops keycaps off the keyboard.
tools.lighter: Lighter: a small flame that singes away hairs.
tools.snips: Wire snips: cut old strings and wire.
tools.sandgun: Sandblaster: blasts paint and rust down to bare metal.
tools.laser: Laser engraver: burns logos and lettering in.
tools.oil: Oil can: puts a drop of oil on each moving joint.
tools.compound: Cleaning compound: a paste that lifts tarnish and grime.
tools.filler: Repair filler: fills cracks and holes.
tools.finish: Finish brush: brushes on the protective top coat.

padlock.chip: Chip the rust lumps off the lock.
padlock.electro: Electrolysis bath lifts the remaining rust.
padlock.key: Heat the keyhole, then twist out the stuck key.
padlock.split: Split the lock body open along the seam.
padlock.wheel: Wire-wheel every part to bright steel.
padlock.blue: Brush on cold bluing for a blue-black finish.
padlock.refit: Put the levers, shackle and plate back.
padlock.rivets: Tap each rivet to peen it shut.
padlock.test: Turn the key; the shackle springs open.

knife.crust: Knock the rust crust off the knife.
knife.seam: Cut open the seam between blade and handle.
knife.scrape: Scrape off the loosened black scale.
knife.wheel: Wire-wheel the knife to bright steel.
knife.pins: Punch out the pins so the knife comes apart.
knife.sharpen: Long, slow strokes hone the edge.
knife.ring: Heat the wire red-hot and bend a new bail ring.
knife.oil: Brush on oil; the knife is riveted back together.
knife.fold: Flick the blade open and shut.

sword.handle: Slide the handle off the tang.
sword.polish: Polish the blade to a mirror.
sword.attach: Slide the grip back onto the tang.
sword.secure: Tap each brass rivet to hammer it flush.

lighter.shell: Slide the case off the insert.
lighter.polish: Polish the body until it gleams.
lighter.mech: Refit the flint wheel and shaft.
lighter.test: Flip the lid open and shut.

watch.back: Unscrew the case back with the case wrench.
watch.hands: Take the hands off the centre post.
watch.dial: Brush the dust off the dial.
watch.time: Wind the crown; the hands move.

keyboard.brush: Brush out the hair and crumbs.
keyboard.singe: Singe away the last stuck hairs.
keyboard.dishwasher: Load the parts and run the dishwasher.
keyboard.uv: A peroxide and UV bath whitens the yellowed plastic.
keyboard.led: Polish the hazy LED window clear.

clock.movement: Pry the back off and pull out the movement.
clock.acid: A citric acid bath dissolves the rust.
clock.polish: Polish the brass plates and bells.
clock.sand: Fill and sand the case smooth.
clock.dial: Fit the new dial, hands and glass.
clock.wind: Wind it up; it ticks and rings.

guitar.strip: Pull off the pickguard, bridge and neck.
guitar.poles: Polish the rusty pickup poles to chrome.
guitar.frets: Tap each slot to press in a new fret.
guitar.tune: Circle each peg; the string glides into tune.

typewriter.blast: Sandblast the panels to bare metal.
typewriter.logo: Laser the Olympia logo back on.
typewriter.refit: Drop the carriage back on its rails.

pistol.parts: Fit the butt cap, ramrod and pins.

handLabels.Bare Hands: Hands: drag, lift and fit parts by hand.
handLabels.Cleaning Tank: Cleaning tank: the bath the object is lowered into.
handLabels.Cleaning Jar: Cleaning jar: the bath the parts are lowered into.
handLabels.Case Wrench: Case wrench: unscrews the watch back.
handLabels.Winding Key: Winding key: winds the clock spring.
handLabels.Tuning Pegs: Tuning pegs: tighten each string to pitch.
handLabels.Slider: Slider: drag it to compare before and after.
